newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals settle up for second session.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals settle up for second session.

text.p: New York precious metals futures ended higher for the second session Thursday, recovering from contract lows set Tuesday when spot gold plumbed a three-year nadir.

"Some aggressive short term traders are buying the market's oversold condition, encouraging a short covering rally, but we're not impressed with the bounce really," Linnco Futures Group trader Anthony Raia in Chicago said.
"Once the technical indicators have been repaired, we think the longer term bearish scenario will be little changed," he said.
